evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), an explicit organization/presentation cue and a separate origin/status field are present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is related to identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists identified contents (colored sets) with attribute labels and coordinate values.

D.rationale: Origin/provenance metadata is recorded separately from the content (colored coordinate sets), distinguishing content identity from status/provenance.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized/presented (grid orientation) and provides per-item origin/presentation metadata.
